items.root_cause: Three mechanisms, one per failure. (a) Get-ItemPrice's cents branch reads the first cents-shaped token anywhere in an ad line and the parser only knows the savings shapes it has been taught one at a time (PERKS, FUEL SAVER on 09-07, SAVE 50c today): measured over every ads-*.json on disk, 145 distinct lines carry a cents token AND a dollar token and in ALL 145 the cents token is a reward or a savings, never the price (139 fuel-saver, 4 SAVE-cents, 2 '50c off with digital coupon'), while the 60 cents-only lines are all fuel-saver lines with no price. (b) The wrong-class library scopes on the deals page's display taxonomy, so a display bucket that mixes nuts with drinks ('Snacks & Drinks', 39 commodities, 21 non-drink) can never carry the beverage class, and audit-food-category is structurally blind to a beverage crowning any of those 21; 400 of 592 commodities carry no per-commodity beverage exclude at all. (c) compare-deals refuses on price before it refuses on definition, so the band-censorship ratchet counts definitional refusals as price censorship, and its cell count moves when a PEER's sale moves the median, not when anything new is refused.

root_fix.what: (a) make the cents branch structural: a cents token is never the price when the line also carries a $ amount; (b) let category-excludes.json scope a class by commodity id, not only by display category, and apply the beverage class to the nut commodities through that block; (c) definitional refusals (piece size) run before sanity refusals (band) in the engine
